result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `period_workday_dates` treated `period_end` (00:00 on the 1st of the next month, exclusive) as an inclusive date. For UTC that added Oct 1, a Thursday, so September 2026 counted 23 workdays instead of 22.

The end date now comes from the last instant before `period_end`, so September 2026 counts 22.

The 53 pace-related tests pass. I started the full suite, but it was still running when I stopped waiting, so I haven't seen its result.
